errors.evidence: The description lists the categories in the order 'Под 5 г.', '5-10 г.', and 'Над 5 г.'. The actual order on the chart from top to bottom is 'Над 5 г.', '5-10 г.', and 'Под 5 г.'.
The description claims that the horizontal axis has intervals of approximately 10%. The chart image does not show any tick marks or intervals on this axis.
The description uses the word for 'height' (височината) to describe the dimension of the bars that represents value. Since this is a horizontal bar chart, the correct term is 'length' (дължината).
